programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: South Park: La passion du juif

programme.title: South Park: Les Gluants
programme.desc: Des humains de l'an 4035 débarquent à South Park à travers un portail temporel et recherchent du travail.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jefferson
programme.desc: Une nouvelle famille arrive à South Park : les Jefferson. Monsieur Jefferson accueille les enfants de South Park chez lui pour les faire jouer dans son parc personnel.

programme.title: South Park: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca
programme.desc: La SPA manifeste contre l'utilisation d'une vache comme mascotte de l'école élémentaire de South Park. Les écoliers sont obligés d'en choisir une autre.
programme.sub-title: Poire à lavement et sandwich au caca

programme.title: South Park: Le Supermarché des Ténèbres
programme.desc: La rue principale de South Park se transforme en ville fantôme quand un supermarché géant Wall Mart attire les citadins jusqu'à son tout nouveau magasin aux affaires incroyables.

programme.title: South Park: Maternelle
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que Trent Boyett est en prison. Celui-ci y est incarcéré, à la place des garçons, pour avoir brûlé leur professeur de maternelle. Quand il sort de prison, les enfants paniquent alors à l'idée de sa vengeance.

programme.title: South Park: Course à l'audience

programme.sub-title: Kit vidéo pour stupide pute trop gâtée

programme.title: South Park: Le don incroyable de Cartman

programme.title: South Park: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt

programme.sub-title: Le Noël des petits animaux de la forêt

programme.title: South Park: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison

programme.sub-title: Le Vagin tout neuf de M. Garrison

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Strange Event at Roman Fall
programme.desc: A wife reports her husband, a reclusive mystery writer, has fallen off a cliff. Suspicion points to her as the killer and Colonel March investigates.
programme.sub-title: The Strange Event at Roman Fall

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Headless Hat
programme.desc: While on holiday in France, there is a murder at the docks and Colonel March is asked by a friend of the French police to assist.

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Second Mona Lisa
programme.desc: The Second Mona Lisa,' painted six months after the first, is targeted by rival collectors. Colonel March is determined to reveal the truth.

programme.title: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Death In Inner Space
programme.desc: A scientist seeks a way to suspend bodily life functions during space travel, and his test subject dies from lack of oxygen. Accident or foul play?

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: Island Escape
programme.desc: A rescue team is sent to a remote island which is surrounded by a wormhole which resets time every 3 days, and also crawling with hideous monsters.

programme.title: Haunting In Connecticut 2: Ghost Of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: We Are the Flesh
programme.desc: After wandering a ruined city for years in search of food and shelter, two siblings find their way into one of the last remaining buildings. Inside, they find a man who will make them a dangerous offer to survive the outside world.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Mink Coat
programme.desc: While vacationing, Peter's sister becomes convinced that the inner-lining of an airplane passenger's fur coat is being used for smuggling purposes.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Locked Room
programme.desc: Peter must infiltrate an embassy to rescue a Russian scientist who wants to defect and has been working to solve the problem of invisibility.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Jail Break
programme.desc: Peter vows to help an innocent men unjustly sentenced to prison for a crime he didn't commit and must find the real thief.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Blind Justice
programme.desc: When an airline pilot is framed for drug smuggling, a killer comes to his home to silence him... and the pilot's blind wife (Honor Blackman) is the only witness.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Bank Raid
programme.desc: Kidnappers abduct Peter's niece and hold her ransom for $50,000. To get her back safely, Dr. Brady is forced to steal the money from a bank vault.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Strange Partners
programme.desc: A wealthy man uses extortion and a trained attack dog to force Peter to kill his partner and make it look like a heart attack.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Odds Against Death
programme.desc: A gangster forces one of Peter's staff to developed a mathematical system to win at the roulette table.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Picnic With Death
programme.desc: Peter's existence as an invisible man becomes public knowledge, while Sally's friend needs help when her stepfather plots to kill her invalid mother.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Play to Kill
programme.desc: A celebrated actress runs down a hobo by accident and a witness blackmails her, threatening to expose her secret.

programme.title: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Rocket
programme.desc: A top-secret rocket is compromised when one of the scientists runs into gambling debts. Peter heads out on a desperate search for the missing rocket.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Ye Gods

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: If She Dies

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: South Park: With Apologies to Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: With Apologies to Jessie Jackson: Randy faces public ridicule for using the "N" word on live TV. Cartman can't resist teasing a little person who comes to school to teach about prejudice. (S11, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Cartman Sucks
programme.desc: Cartman Sucks: After being caught in a compromising position with Eric, Butters is sent to a special camp to "Pray the Gay Away". Cartman tries to retrieve the incriminating photo. (S11, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Lice Capades
programme.desc: Lice Capades: Eric tries to discover the source of an outbreak of lice at the school. The lice are living peacefully in a village until they see the school nurse staring at them! (S11, E03)

programme.title: South Park: The Snuke
programme.desc: The Snuke: The citizens of South Park are gearing up for the arrival of Hillary Clinton. Eric suspects that a new student is planning a terrorist attack but the real culprits are deadlier. (S11, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Fantastic Easter Special
programme.desc: Fantastic Easter Special: Stan sets out to find a reason for painting Easter eggs and discovers his father is part of a society called "The Hare Club For Men", but all is not what it seems. (S11, E05)

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: D-Yikes!: Ms. Garrison decides that she is a lesbian after getting dumped again but hell breaks loose when her new favourite lesbian bar faces a takeover from Persians in a '300' stylee. (S11, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Night of the Living Homeless
programme.desc: Night of the Living Homeless: When a plague of homeless people hits South Park, the boys devise a plan to move them on whilst the adults panic like they're in a zombie movie. (S11, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Le Petite Tourette: Cartman experiences bliss when he discovers that, by pretending to have Tourettes, he can say whatever he likes to whoever he likes! Naturally, national TV beckons. (S11, E08)

programme.title: South Park: More Cr*p
programme.desc: More Cr*p: Inadvertently, Randy breaks the world record for the 'biggest cr*p'! Bono, the previous holder, is determined to regain his crown - but he has a dark secret which may stop him. (S11, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode I
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode I: The boys find themselves in a magical land where all of the world's imagination is laid out before them. (S11, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode II
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode II: The government are holding Stan and Kyle captive, to find out how they got into Imaginationland. Butters is in trouble with evil creatures like Snarf! (S11, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode III
programme.desc: Imaginationland- Episode III: Stan and Butters are stuck in Imaginationland fighting for their lives, while Cartman goes all the way to the supreme court to get Kyle to pay up on their bet. (S11, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Guitar Queer-o: Stan and Kyle are set to hit big time with their skills on computer game Guitar Hero. Their manager convinces Stan that Kyle is holding him back. Will the "band" break up? (S11, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The List
programme.desc: The List: The boys steal a list from the girls which rates their looks from the cutest to the ugliest. Spirits plummet, while for others egos inflate! Can the ghost of Abraham Lincoln help? (S11, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Tonsil Trouble
programme.desc: Tonsil Trouble: A botched blood transfusion results in Cartman getting AIDS. How far will he go to find a cure? Kyle had better watch out... (S12, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Britney's New Look
programme.desc: Britney's New Look: The media circus arrives in South Park as Britney Spears hides in the town. After a photo of her urinating on a ladybug sells for $100,000 the boys have a brain wave. (S12, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Major B**bage
programme.desc: Major B**bage: The hysterical parents of South Park have another reason to panic after 'cheesing' becomes popular among kids. Kenny becomes addicted to the out-of-this-world hallucinations. (S12, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Canada on Strike
programme.desc: Canada on Strike: Canada is brought to the brink of collapse after a drawn out strike in pursuit of 'some of that internet money'. Can the boys save the day with a "YouToob" sensation? (S12, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Eek, A Pen*s!
programme.desc: Eek, A Pen*s! Ms. Garrison wants to become a man again, so whilst she is away Cartman becomes the sub teacher. It's not long before Cartman is teaching innercity kids the fun of cheating! (S12, E05)

programme.title: Te Presumo
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de un empresario que tiene la vida ideal. Un día cuando regresa de una carrera de motos en la que su hijo gano el primer lugar todo da un vuelco en sus vidas.

programme.title: Texas Huele a Sangre
programme.desc: Un sheriff de Texas quiere poner orden en su condado, pero se enfrenta a un violento narcotraficante que intenta imponer su ley a toda costa lo que desatara una impresionante oleada de violencia y sangre.

programme.title: Tierra de Narcotraficantes
programme.desc: El comandante dedica tanto tiempo a su trabajo que descuida a su propia familia y su hijo crece sin el cariño y atención de un padre el niño al entrar a la adolescencia se va por el mal camino equivocado ingresando a la mafia.

programme.title: Tierra sin ley
programme.desc: En algún lugar del noreste de México, donde el crimen organizado ha creado un paraíso para el narcotráfico. Nacho Montoya regresa a casa para vengar la muerte de sus padres. Junto con su hermano y un grupo de amigos cazadores, se dan a la tarea.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo
programme.desc: El Descenso de “El Mayo” una visión única del mundo del narcotráfico desde la perspectiva de uno de los líderes más astutos y enigmáticos del Cártel de Sinaloa. Revelando las decisiones cruciales que debe tomar para mantenerse al frente de su imperio.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo Parte 2
programme.desc: Después de la detención del Mayo la violencia se ha desatado con gran fuerza en el estado de Sinaloa, Joaquín desesperado al ver retrasadas las negociaciones con Estados Unidos lidia una guerra contra Isarael Zavala, hijo de Mario.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo Parte 3
programme.desc: La guerra entre familias del narcotráfico continua en Sinaloa, Joaquín junto a su hermanos Archí y Jonás preparan una alianza con el cartel de Guadalajara algo que inclinaría claramente la balanza de su lado en la guerra contra Israel Zavala.

programme.title: Traición al Mayo Parte 4
programme.desc: Archí, Israel y la Colombiana se alian en contra del cartel de Sinaloa, mientras la organización se divide y continúan con sus enfrentamientos para controlar el negocio luego del arresto del Mayo. Mientras Joaquín inicia sus negociaciones con la DEA.

programme.title: Un Dia de Campamento
programme.desc: Una gran película para toda la familia que se sucede en la escuela de un pueblo mágico, con grandes aventuras y conocimiento de sus tradiciones entre juegos y aventuras sin fin.

programme.title: El Charro De Cristo
programme.desc: Narra la historia de un hombre conocido como el charro de cristo, quien mata en defensa propia al hijo de un rico hacendado que pretende a la mujer que el ama. Por su parte el padre de este jura vengarse y confina a la muchacha.

programme.title: El Pueblo Fantasma
programme.desc: Manuel Saldívar el texano llega a un pueblo dominado por un pistolero llamado Rio Kid, que le revela que su progenitor era un asesino. El texano decide limpiar su nombre haciendo el bien.

programme.title: El Rio De Las Animas
programme.desc: Leonardo Moncada y Pedro, son un par de amigos que llegan cabalgando hasta un pueblo llamado pueblo viejo. A su llegada se percatan que algo extraño está sucediendo y están en lo correcto ya que se dan cuenta que la gente de pueblo.

programme.title: Juan El Desalmado
programme.desc: Juan, hijo de un indio y una blanca, pierde a sus padres a manos de una banda de desalmados bandidos comandados por un par de hermanos, quienes acostumbran a cambiar su nombre para despistar a sus seguidores.

programme.title: La Trinchera
programme.desc: Rómulo, mejor conocido como El Cascabel regresa a su pueblo en busca de su gran amada Maria, pero pronto se da cuenta que su reputación es la de un asesino ya que estuvo en la cárcel y quiere limpiar su imagen dejando atrás sus armas.

programme.title: La Vuelta Del Mexicano
programme.desc: Carlos es un seminarista que trata de cumplir la misión que le dejo su hermano Jacinto, de hacer que el pueblo de Estados Unidos respete a los Mexicanos. En su camino se encuentra con una mujer de quien se enamora y por quien se enfrenta en un duelo.

programme.title: Las Leandras
programme.desc: Un director teatral usa un antiguo prostíbulo para sus ensayos y lo hace pasar por un colegio de señoritas para que su novia pueda cobrar una herencia.

programme.title: Los Murciélagos
programme.desc: Leonardo Moncada en su camino a San Miguel se topa con un hombre llamado Ramiro a quien ayudan ya que horas antes fue despojado de su caballo y pertenencias. Ramiro le pide a leonardo que si lo puede llevar a las Vegas.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: Cinco cazadores de élite pagan para cazar a un hombre en una isla desierta. Pero cuando su presa comienza a defenderse, los roles de cazadores y de la presa cambian de lado…

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: En el juego del Asesino
programme.desc: La policía detiene a un psicópata al que se le relaciona con múltiples raptos y asesinatos de mujeres, pero su captura será solo el principio de una cuenta atrás en busca de sus víctimas

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: Huo An es un comandante de la Brigada de Protección de las regiones occidentales, que se ve envuelto en las garras del mal y queda esclavizado.

programme.title: 12 horas (Gone)
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried (El precio del mañana, La chica de la capa roja) interpreta este intenso thriller acerca de una joven desesperada que, tras ser ignorada por la policía, debe salir a buscar al asesino serial que ella cree secuestró a su hermana menor.

programme.title: La Linea
programme.desc: El inestable nuevo jefe de un cártel de la droga de Tijuana es el objetivo de un asesino para eliminarlo.

programme.title: Sniper: special ops
programme.desc: Un francotirador y su compañero quedan atrapados en territorio enemigo tras un fallido rescate de un congresista secuestrado por los talibanes. Ahora deben sobrevivir y esperar a su unidad.

programme.title: Until Death
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme interpreta a un teniente sucio al que le gusta la heroína. Es amigo de los mafiosos del crimen organizado y todos lo odian.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: El efecto de calentamiento está creando nuevas regiones de clima extremo, pero algo más lo está desencadenando; algo que cuando se combina con olas de calor récord crea explosiones en el cielo.

programme.title: EL Rascacielos
programme.desc: Una guerra de clases se desata en una propiedad residencial de lujo y se desarrolla una verdadera batalla en los ascensores, pasillos y apartamentos de la moderna torre.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: En el centenario del viaje original, un moderno y lujoso barco bautizado como "Titanic 2" sigue el camino de su homónimo.

programme.title: 500 MPH Storm
programme.desc: Cuando un experimento de energía se descontrola, una serie de huracanes masivos azotan América del Norte. Un científico debe poner a su familia a salvo antes de que los huracanes se fusionen.

programme.title: Shark Week
programme.desc: Un grupo de completos extraños se encuentran aislados por un loco rico en el complejo de su isla. Se ven obligados a entrar en un guantelete espantoso donde deben sobrevivir a un aluvión de especies de tiburones cada vez más letales.

programme.title: Snow Shark
programme.desc: Hace 12 años, durante una expedición científica, 3 biólogos animales tropezaron con un gran descubrimiento que terminó en tragedia. Lo que los mató ha despertado, y ahora la leyenda de la Bestia de Nieve Antigua podría ser más que solo una leyenda.

programme.title: Final days of planet earth
programme.desc: Después de que Lloyd y Marianne descubren que Liz Quinlan y otros funcionarios del gobierno han sido tomados por alienígenas disfrazados de humanos, su única esperanza yace en la sangre del Comandante William Phillips.

programme.title: Final days of planet earth
programme.desc: Después de que Lloyd y Marianne descubren que Liz Quinlan y otros funcionarios del gobierno han sido tomados por alienígenas disfrazados de humanos, su única esperanza yace en la sangre del Comandante William Phillips.

programme.title: La Bruja de los Cabellos Blancos
programme.desc: Historia de dos amantes, la bruja de pelo blanco y el líder taoísta Zhuo Yihang y su amor que podría cambiar el destino de la nación.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mark Corvo tiene un don espiritual que podría costarle la vida. Regresa a vivir en la casa de su infancia y allí se enfrenta a fuerzas oscuras que intentan matarlo. Los investigadores paranormales descubren que se ha abierto un portal en la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un adolescente incursiona en el ocultismo y un espíritu maligno aterroriza a toda la familia en su nuevo hogar.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Edwin González y Lillian Otero creían haber encontrado la casa de sus sueños, pero pronto se convierte en una pesadilla. Todo cambia tras la aparición de un ser. Lillian es poseída por un espíritu maligno y atacada violentamente.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Dos entidades vagan por una granja de 200 años de antigüedad, aterrorizando a la familia que vive allí; pero están decididos a quedarse en la casa, aumentando la actividad paranormal a niveles amenazantes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Dos hermanos se encuentran con una entidad demoníaca en los bosques alrededor de su casa en Florida y se enfrentan a ella décadas después.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una entidad oscura se despierta en una mansión del siglo XIX; la familia Rice experimenta una aterradora persecución y finalmente tiene que abandonar la casa de sus sueños.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia se muda a una casa con una historia oscura y oculta y pronto se percatan de que no están solos. Los rituales oscuros y la muerte han atraído al mal a la casa y los niños son su objetivo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando un implacable demonio amenaza con la vida de la familia Cupit, un equipo de investigadores paranormales y demonólogos luchan contra la fuerza del mal para obligarla a regresar al infierno.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una serie de eventos inexplicables dejan al descubierto una larga historia de muerte en torno a la nueva casa de los Yaple. Cuando la familia es atacada, buscan ayuda especializada antes de que el demonio que cambia de forma aumente su crueldad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia descubre una habitación secreta en su nueva casa, enfureciendo a un fantasma que hará lo imposible para expulsarlos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Durante su visita, la madre de Taylor abre la casa al mundo de los muertos, buscan ayuda de investigadores paranormales y descubren la atrocidad que ocurrió en el ático años atrás.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Anita y su hijo se enfrentan a un demonio que usa un antiguo artefacto para abrir portales en su casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia sospecha que alguien merodea su casa y descubre la presencia de un fantasma que murió trágicamente en la propiedad. La situación se torna violenta. ¿Podrá la familia recuperar su casa antes de que sea demasiado tarde?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tras un escalofriante encuentro con una momia egipcia, un joven es perseguido por el ente para robarle el alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una adolescente experimenta con el ocultismo y la oscuridad es atraída a su casa de Alaska. El espíritu ataca a la familia y, al ver que sus vidas peligran, buscan la ayuda de expertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia limpió la casa de un pariente mayor, pero las cajas no fueron lo único que llevaron a casa.

programme.title: Piernas De Oro
programme.desc: En una carrera de bicicletas, Clavillazo vence a Esteban quien siempre había sido el campeón municipal. El coronel García ordena que formen una cuarteta con Clavillazo. Esteban y otros, para correr en la vuelta al centro de la república.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Que Lindo Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: El diablo, molesto porque Don Candido, el presidente municipal de un pueblo esta moralizando las costumbres del pueblo que gobierna, envia a uno de sus subordinados a la tierra para corromper el ambiente mediante la organizacion de un cabaret.

programme.title: Recien Casados... No Molestar
programme.desc: Catalina y Andres son una joven pareja a punto de casarse. Cada uno tiene su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y amigas respectivamente, donde intentan hacerles ver los pros y los contras del matrimonio con un poco de satira.

programme.title: Rumba Caliente
programme.desc: Ticha es una joven cuyo trabajo es ser vendedora de cigarros y dulces en el teatro, con el sueño de triunfar como actriz y ser como la Vedette Lily del mar quien trabaja en una de las obras exhibidas en el teatro.

programme.title: Santo Vs El Estrangulador
programme.desc: Cosas extrañas suceden en el teatro de una localidad donde se presentan diversas obras musicales, ya que alguien ha estado matando a varias bailarinas y actrices de dichas obras.

programme.title: Si Volvieras A Mi
programme.desc: Pedro cuenca, medico de profesión, se muda con su amigo y colega el doctor montes roca para llevar a cabo su ano de residencia como médico rural. Allí conoce a la hija de su anfitrión, la bella Alejandra.

programme.title: Tú, Solo Tú
programme.desc: Un joven hombre proveniente del Estado de Jalisco viaja a la capital en busca de su novia Paloma. A su llegada a la capital se sorprende de que su gran amada trabaja como fichera en un cabaret de mala muerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC se enamora de la nueva vice-directora de la escuela. Mientras tanto, Terrance y Phillip quieren firmar un contrato con Netflix, y Kyle está cansado de ser humillado por Heidi y Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de South Park están enojados ya que el presidente está asustando a sus hijos. Los niños parten con el fin de desentrañar el gran misterio de Garrison al estilo It y Stranger Things.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy está desesperado por ayudar a Sharon a controlar sus emociones y Cartman reprueba inesperadamente su examen de matemáticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Se ha desarrollado una relación muy especial entre Butters y el sacerdote de su parroquia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El comportamiento ofensivo del Sr. Mojón lo pone en riesgo de ser despedido como director del espectáculo anual de Navidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters está vendiendo vaporizadores y todo tipo de sabores frutados en la escuela. Randy decide que debería mudar a la familia al campo y dedicarse a la agricultura.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños planean usar la última revolución en movilidad para obtener más dulces durante la Noche de Brujas de los que obtuvieron antes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South Park están en peligro y los niños descubren que solo Al Gore puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos salen de la cárcel y huyen de la policía y del Hombre-Oso-Cerdo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La competencia anual Mujer Fuerte lleva a todos a sus límites.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La madre de Kyle se hace un trasplante fecal y los niños están en busca del mejor microbioma.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Scott Malkinson está desesperado por impresionar a la chica nueva de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Papá Noel se está robando toda la alegría de la temporada navideña de la ciudad.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: La prestigiosa escritora e historiadora Deborah E. Lipstadt debe luchar por la verdad histórica para demostrar que el Holocausto ocurrió realmente cuando David Irving, un renombrado negacionista, la demanda por difamación.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Tucker: El hombre y su sueño
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: Calígula
programme.desc: Detalla la historia impactante, pero innegablemente trágica, del césar más infame de Roma, Calígula.

programme.title: La verdad puede matar
programme.desc: Un conductor enfrenta a la amante musulmana de su jefe fallecido y a su primo gánster.

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Cuatro madres salen a cenar juntas y terminan viviendo una noche inesperada llena de aventuras.

programme.title: La Mirada
programme.desc: Dramaturga duda entre manipulación y perder la realidad.

programme.title: ISRA-88
programme.desc: Un científico y un piloto se ofrecen voluntarios para una misión de alto nivel destinada a llegar al fin del universo. Después de 13 años, la nave se estrella en el fin del universo y se adentra en lo desconocido.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino

programme.sub-title: Dos jóvenes masacradas: el caso Leconte

programme.title: Memoria Negra: La Desaparición De Andrea Illona Budach

programme.sub-title: La Desaparición De Andrea Illona Budach

programme.title: Memoria Negra: Operación San Antonio

programme.title: Grupo 2: Homicidios: Premonición

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Nancy es una mujer con un historial de relaciones fallidas. Una infancia dura la ha hecho sentirse rota y poco querida. A sus 43 años, se ha casado y divorciado tres veces.

programme.title: Belleza mortal
programme.desc: Teresa Pérez, una bella cazafortunas, cree que por fin encontró el amor junto a Justyn Rosen, un hombre casado. Cuando el rico hombre de negocios termina la relación con su joven amante, Teresa se venga de Justyn con un secuestro impactante.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Secuestrada

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers

When he finds a vital clue that may finally pinpoint the treasure's whereabouts, he drags Tess and her boss, billionaire Nigel Honeycutt, along on the hunt. A female student named Drey (Shareeka Epps) catches him in a drug-induced haze after a basketball game, and the two strike up an unlikely friendship. As Dan struggles with his addiction, he tries to act as a mentor to the girl, whose brother is serving time for dealing drugs.

programme.title: Roald Dahl's Esio Trot
programme.desc: A magical, warm–hearted family film with universal appeal. Mr Hoppy, a retired bachelor, harbours a secret passion for his neighbour, the lovely Mrs Silver. Unfortunately, she lavishes all her affection on another, Alfie, her pet tortoise. Mr Hoppy yearns to talk to Mrs Silver, but tongue-tied and shy, his attempts always end in disaster. And when Mr Pringle, a boorish next-door neighbour, asks Mrs Silver out on a date, Mr Hoppy's world falls apart. Mrs Silver's greatest wish is for her tortoise, Alfie, to grow a little bigger. All is lost for Mr Hoppy until he has the brightest and most devious of ideas to win his lady's heart. Starring Academy Award winners Judi Dench and Dustin Hoffman, ESIO TROT is endearing and wonderful for the whole family .

Rickman, Grant and Greg Wise co-star as the well-intentioned suitors who are trapped by the strict rules of society and the conflicting laws of desire.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Salif Keita, Souleymane Dournbia, Lansine Kouyate & N'Doumbé
programme.desc: Salif Keita's music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita's music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux). He achieved international acknowledgement with this band in the 1970s. After spending a couple of years in Ivory Coast, Salif has found his home base in Paris since 1984. During this 2010 concert, he proves to be rightfully referred to as “The Golden Voice of Africa”.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Among his five concertos, Violin Concerto No. 4 is one of the best-known. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland II
programme.desc: Experience the wonders of summertime in Iceland from an elevated perspective with "Flying Over Iceland II: Summer in the Golden Circle". Filmed during quarantine in September of 2020, ambient film features an immersive slow-moving aerial perspective of some of Islandia's most iconic and famous south coast loop locations - all in glorious sunlight. Beginning at the stunning 200 foot high Skogafoss waterfall, viewers next are gently flown to the charming coastal city of Vik, which overlooks the famous Vikurfjara Black Sand Beach. Here ancient lava flows have sculpted some impressive coastal outcroppings which viewers will witness from a bird's eye view, before soaring to great heights in order to witness the distant glaciers and unique geography of South Iceland as never seen before. From the black sand beach we then soar west to the charming Dyrholaey Lighthouse, which also sits atop some absolutely stunning coastal rock formations including a giant arch at sea level. After returning to Vik the film next progresses to the glacier Vatnajökull, offering majestic views of Iceland's largest glacier. From soaring above the misty clouds to dipping down into the ice formations, the film ends with multiple unique perspectives of the glacial area including young pine forests, a visit from some local sheep, and a journey above and below the clouds for one final refreshing cap to the 1 hour film.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Caught up in a conspiracy, a top-notch negotiator ends up in a tight spot when he's falsely accused of killing his partner and stealing from the department's pension fund. programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: Walking Tall
programme.desc: Chris Vaughn, a retired soldier who returns to his hometown only to discover the place he grew up is now overrun with crime, drugs and violence. Enlisting the help of his old pal, Chris gets elected Sheriff and fights to clean up his hometown.

programme.title: Runner, Runner
programme.desc: A college student (Justin Timberlake) takes the ultimate gamble when he goes to Costa Rica to confront the online gaming tycoon (Ben Affleck) who cheated him out of his winnings.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Stranded in a remote town with a car that wont work and no way to pay the local repair shop, THE JANITOR agrees to spend the night in an abandoned theme park full of animatronic characters that were once a joy to the kids of the town, but now hold a dark secret. As night falls, these once happy mascots come to life and theyre out for blood. Survive at any cost, its only one night!

programme.title: The Hatton Garden Job
programme.desc: A remarkable true story of the largest heist in English legal history. Four ageing East End criminals led by 76 year-old Brian Reader (Larry Lamb) drill into a steel-and-concrete secured safety deposit vault in Londons Hatton Garden jewellery quarter. With everyone from the Hungarian mob to Scotland Yard on their tail, will they commit the crime of the century or pay with their lives?

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: Inspired by astonishing true events, Aftermath tells the story of two strangers, Roman Melnyk, (Arnold Schwarzenegger: The Expendables), and an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy: Argo), whose lives become inextricably bound together after a devastating plane crash that resulted in the death of Romans family. A heart-pounding thriller brought to you by the producers of Everest.

programme.title: Honeydew
programme.desc: For Sam and Rylie an idyllic camping trip becomes an out of control nightmare. Seeking shelter on a local farm overnight when their car encounters trouble on the road, the couple find themselves at the mercy of an ageing farmer and her peculiar son.

programme.title: Open Grave
programme.desc: This twisted thriller will keep you guessing until the bitter end. Waking up in a pit of dead bodies with no memory, a man joins forces with a group of strangers. Together they must figure out who is behind the mysterious mass killings. But suspicions give way to violence, as they piece together their identities and discover a much more vicious and deadly threat to their survival.

programme.title: Curtain Call
programme.desc: With opening night fast approaching, a beloved Broadway star must overcome insurmountable odds to deliver the performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Dating My Past
programme.desc: A couples therapy expert thinks back on what she's learned from her relationships with three exes: one with whom she can't deny the chemistry, one a sensitive artist, and one that's seemingly too perfect.

programme.title: Acidman
programme.desc: When Maggie tracks down her estranged and reclusive father, she discovers the paranormal phenomena that he has been investigating and together they attempt to make first contact.

programme.title: I Am Woman
programme.desc: The story of Helen Reddy, who in 1966 landed in NYC with her three-year-old daughter, a suitcase and $230 in her pocket. Within five years she was one of the biggest superstars of her time, and an icon of the 1970s feminist movement.

programme.title: The Baker's Son
programme.desc: The locals of Windwards Island always knows when talented baker Matt has fallen in love, his loaves taste delicious. So, when his bread stops tasting bland, is it due to the newcomer or friend Annie?

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Salif Keita, Souleymane Dournbia, Lansine Kouyate & N'Doumbé
programme.desc: Salif Keita's music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita's music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux). He achieved international acknowledgement with this band in the 1970s. After spending a couple of years in Ivory Coast, Salif has found his home base in Paris since 1984. During this 2010 concert, he proves to be rightfully referred to as “The Golden Voice of Africa”.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Among his five concertos, Violin Concerto No. 4 is one of the best-known. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland II
programme.desc: Experience the wonders of summertime in Iceland from an elevated perspective with "Flying Over Iceland II: Summer in the Golden Circle". Filmed during quarantine in September of 2020, ambient film features an immersive slow-moving aerial perspective of some of Islandia's most iconic and famous south coast loop locations - all in glorious sunlight. Beginning at the stunning 200 foot high Skogafoss waterfall, viewers next are gently flown to the charming coastal city of Vik, which overlooks the famous Vikurfjara Black Sand Beach. Here ancient lava flows have sculpted some impressive coastal outcroppings which viewers will witness from a bird's eye view, before soaring to great heights in order to witness the distant glaciers and unique geography of South Iceland as never seen before. From the black sand beach we then soar west to the charming Dyrholaey Lighthouse, which also sits atop some absolutely stunning coastal rock formations including a giant arch at sea level. After returning to Vik the film next progresses to the glacier Vatnajökull, offering majestic views of Iceland's largest glacier. From soaring above the misty clouds to dipping down into the ice formations, the film ends with multiple unique perspectives of the glacial area including young pine forests, a visit from some local sheep, and a journey above and below the clouds for one final refreshing cap to the 1 hour film.

programme.title: Crónicas de un crimen

programme.title: El limpiabotas
